events.text:
Thank you, Grace. Your identity is verified.

I found the charge. It's order O-5109 from Burger Barn for $28.10, placed October 23 at 1:10 PM and marked as delivered. I've passed it to a human specialist as an unrecognized charge, along with your concern that someone may have accessed your account. Reference number: ESC-700. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours.

I can't refund or credit this charge myself, so the specialist will decide what happens with it. In the meantime, I'd suggest changing your Forkful password and checking your card statement for any other charges you don't recognize. If you see any, tell the specialist.

Is there anything else I can help with?
Burger Barn? I've never ordered from them. Also, I can't just get the money back now? It's my money and I'd like it back today if you can do that.

I understand the frustration, and I'm sorry this happened. Here's what I can and can't do.

**Why I can't refund it now:** Charges you say you didn't make have to go to a specialist, and I'm not able to refund or credit them myself. I've already sent this to the specialist, and they'll follow up within 24 hours.

**Details from the order:**
- **Items:** Double smash burger ($15.50) and onion rings ($6.00)
- **Total charged:** $28.10, including a $2.99 delivery fee, a $1.61 service fee, and a $2.00 tip
- **Delivery address:** 400 Industrial Pkwy, Unit 9, Riverton, CA 94950. This is not your address on file (15 Orchard St, Oakdale, CA 94609), which is another sign the order may not have been placed by you.

Please pass the delivery address to the specialist when they contact you, and keep your reference number, ESC-700.

Riverton? I've never had anything delivered there. I don't even know where that is. And I don't know who 15 Orchard St is either. Is that address on my account? Someone is clearly using my account, so I need to know if it's safe.

Yes, 15 Orchard St, Oakdale, CA 94609 is the default delivery address on your account. That's the address on file for your profile. The Riverton address on order O-5109 is not one you've given us, and it isn't on your profile.

I can't tell from my tools whether your account was accessed, or how. That's what the specialist (reference ESC-700) will investigate. Until you hear back, these steps will help protect you:

- **Change your Forkful password** right away, and use a password you don't use anywhere else.
- **Check your other accounts** tied to the same email address (gracekim@mailbox.example), especially if you use that password elsewhere.
- **Contact Visa** about the card ending in 4242. They can review the $28.10 charge, block the card, or issue a new one. They can also tell you whether any other charges need attention.
- **Watch your statement** for other charges you don't recognize, and report any you find to the specialist.

I know you want the money back today. I can't refund or credit this charge myself. Visa can also review it as a dispute, which may be faster than waiting for us. Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay, so 15 Orchard St is on my account, but I've never had anything sent to Riverton. Fine, I'll change my password now and call Visa about the card. I'd still rather not wait a day for this, though.

Can you confirm the specialist will email me at gracekim@mailbox.example? And if I don't hear back in 24 hours, what do I do?

I can't confirm how the specialist will reach you. My system only shows that they will follow up within 24 hours. It doesn't say whether that will be by email, phone, or somewhere else, so I don't want to promise a channel.

If you haven't heard back within 24 hours, contact Forkful support and give them reference **ESC-700** and order **O-5109**. That will let them find your case right away.

You're doing the right things by changing your password and calling Visa. I know waiting is frustrating, and I'm sorry you're dealing with this. Is there anything else I can help with today?

Okay. I don't love that I don't know how they'll contact me, but I'll keep an eye on both my email and phone. I'm changing the password now and I'll call Visa about the card.

Thanks for your help. If the specialist can't get the refund sorted, I'll follow up.

I understand, and I'm sorry I can't tell you more about how they'll reach you. Watching both your email and phone is a good idea.

To recap:
- Your case is ESC-700, for order O-5109 ($28.10, Visa ending 4242).
- A specialist will follow up within 24 hours.
- Change your password and call Visa about the card.
- If you don't hear back in 24 hours, contact Forkful support with ESC-700.

Thanks for your patience, Grace. Take care.
